exposure: Women with a previous vaginal delivery
Women with a cervical Bishop score ≥ 5
Women induced for premature rupture of membranes
Vaginal delivery vs. repeat cesarean section
cohort: Pregnant women with one previous cesarean section performed more than 18 months prior
finding: Previous vaginal delivery, Caucasian race, induction of labor for premature rupture of membranes, and a favorable cervical Bishop score were significant predictors of successful induction of labor.
mod_finding: Induction of labor was successful in Caucasian women induced for premature rupture of membranes with a favorable Bishop score.
birth_weight: Babies with a birth weight ≥ 4000 g were more prevalent in women undergoing repeat cesarean section
